mapper.sql: id, title, image, position, link_type, link_value, sort, status, start_time, end_time, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: select from mall_banner where status = 1 and (start_time is null or start_time <= now()) and (end_time is null or end_time >= now()) and position = #{position} order by sort asc, id desc
mapper.insert: insert into mall_banner (title, image, position, link_type, link_value, sort, status, start_time, end_time, create_time, update_time) values (#{title}, #{image}, #{position}, #{linkType}, #{linkValue}, #{sort}, #{status}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update mall_banner set status = #{status}, update_time = now() where id = #{id}
